Your day begins early, between 7:00 and 10:00/11:00, working 3 to 8 hours a week, primarily on Mondays and Thursdays. You'll earn a competitive salary of €14.99 per hour while being part of a friendly team with your own responsibilities. 
Your workday involves unpacking deliveries, sorting clothing and accessories, and ensuring everything is neatly stored in the warehouse. You'll help maintain adequate stock levels in the shop and keep the warehouse tidy with your colleagues. This role keeps you active and engaged, offering support to your team when needed. 
This position is ideal for those seeking a flexible side job. No prior experience is necessary, as you'll quickly learn on the job.
